siikk-Info Bar 4.1

- Warlock: Shadow Trance proc built in, no extra addon needed. When Nightfall procs, a large pulsing Shadow Bolt icon with a 10-second timer appears. It disappears after your next Shadow Bolt.
- Under /il proc (or in the options under "Shadow Trance proc ...") you can move the icon, change its size (32-160 px) and choose one of 5 sounds or turn the sound off.
